title: Parametrization of the Cycloid
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: State the parametric equations of the cycloid generated by a point on a circle of radius a rolling along the x-axis, and find its position when t = pi.
finalAnswer: x(t) = a(t - \sin t), \; y(t) = a(1 - \cos t); \quad \text{At } t = \pi: (\pi a, 2a)

steps.title: State Cycloid Equations
steps.mathExpression: x(t) = a(t - \sin t), \quad y(t) = a(1 - \cos t)
steps.explanation: Standard kinematic equations of rolling circle.

steps.title: Evaluate at t = pi
steps.mathExpression: x(\pi) = a(\pi - \sin(\pi)) = \pi a; \quad y(\pi) = a(1 - \cos(\pi)) = a(1 - (-1)) = 2a
steps.explanation: The vertex of the arch occurs at t = pi at height 2a.
